Frozen test fixtures: decklists and advisors copied from real decks in November 2026. The live decks, with their plans
and advisors, are state in the decks repository and change on their own; these don't follow them.

`boards/design-pass.json` is the game client's design-pass game (`game/tools/fixtures/boards.js`) at turns 4, 9 and 15 as
snapshot envelopes with their catalog entries, for the arrangement engine's goldens and timings. Regenerate it with
`node game/tools/design-boards.js`.
